content.short: Offering a seamless, secure, and user-friendly platform that brings all your digital finance needs under one roof.
content.description:
Gerowallet is here to bridge the gap between Web2 and Web3, offering a seamless, secure, and user-friendly platform that brings all your digital finance needs under one roof. Gero Dashboard gives you access to cashback rewards, native financial integration, governance participation, multichain support with Apex Fusion, staking, swapping, and seamless fiat on & off-ramps—all in one place.

- Crypto Cashback: Shop online with any credit card and receive ADA cashback rewards on your purchases from over 750+ top retailers. Gero DAO: Hold $GERO tokens to propose initiatives, cast votes, and directly influence the development of Gero Dashboard through on-chain governance. Cardano Shield: Built-in phishing protection using machine learning and community insights to safeguard your assets. Swap with DexHunter: Utilize Cardano's largest DEX aggregator to find the best exchange rates across all Cardano DEXes. Earn by Staking: Earn approximately 3% APY by staking your assets directly within the wallet without the need to navigate away. Delegate & Vote: Participate in Cardano governance by casting votes, delegating to representatives, or becoming a representative yourself. Integrated Media Player: Continue managing your crypto while listening to your favorite music NFTs. Non-Custodial: Maintain full control of your finances—your keys, your crypto. Upcoming Features: Rewards Programs zkFiat Integration Market Analysis Tools Referral Program AI Insights

Gerowallet is committed to setting higher standards in security and user experience, putting all our effort into delivering a secure, all-in-one DeFi and Web3 platform on Cardano.
